title: Where to draw the line before AI reaches professional users
description: Explores the critical question of designing conversational AI interfaces for professional users, offering practical guidance on when chat-based layers actually accelerate expert workflows versus when they create friction. The article provides six key questions to evaluate AI implementation strategies before products ship.

title: Nobody asked for the sparkle button
description: A critical examination of why so many products are shipping with AI features that users don't want, arguing that designers should build features with AI rather than AI features themselves. This piece challenges the industry's rush to add AI panels everywhere and offers a more thoughtful approach to AI integration.

title: The context advantage of human UX design thinking
description: Examines the unique value that human designers bring through contextual understanding—a skill that remains advantageous but is increasingly becoming the raw material AI systems are learning to absorb. A timely reflection on what human designers must focus on to remain relevant.

title: Who holds the off switch?
description: Analyzes 2026 privacy and control data to reveal emerging trends in how users are reclaiming agency over their digital experiences and predicts the future direction of the privacy business. A data-driven perspective on a critical UX concern.

title: Who gets to name the future?
description: A provocative essay examining AI's male-dominated culture and how language shapes technology futures, exploring who has power in defining emerging technologies and their societal impact. Raises important questions about diversity and inclusivity in AI product development.

title: Design and engineering are the same thing
description: John Maeda discusses the convergence of design and engineering disciplines, emphasizing why makers must prioritize understanding people and effective communication alongside technical skills. Essential viewing for designers and developers working across disciplines.

title: 5 UX Patterns for Driving Patient Engagement in Healthcare App Design
description: Presents practical, proven UX patterns specifically designed to increase patient engagement in healthcare applications, combining research with real-world design examples. Valuable resource for designers tackling the complex healthcare domain.

title: Small Business Website Design After AI: Nobody Commissions the Plumber's Website Anymore
description: Examines how AI is fundamentally disrupting traditional web design work for small businesses, raising important questions about the future of design commoditization and what designers should focus on next. A realistic take on industry disruption.
